Invention Kit Contents

  1. Breadboard with OLED, LED, buzzer, Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, 6 buttons
  2. 2 Micro servo motors
  3. Joystick module
  4. Distance sensor
  5. Humidity + temperature sensor
  6. Touch sensor
  7. 20 jumper wires
  8. Battery pack
  9. Micro USB cable
